patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with prominent, large-scale text content on the left and dynamic, interactive visual elements (map, property cards) on the right.
Key words within large headings are highlighted with a vibrant linear gradient from pink to orange, drawing immediate attention to core concepts.
Alternating section backgrounds between pure white and a warm, light beige (#F6F2ED) to provide visual segmentation and a subtle sense of warmth and depth.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background map and overlaid property cards scroll at a different rate than the main text content, creating a sense of depth and dynamism.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay to a solid white, sticky header with an integrated search bar as the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Feature and benefit sections are consistently presented as a grid of three cards, each with an icon, bold title, and concise description, facilitating easy scanning.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a layered parallax effect where the background map and foreground content elements move at different speeds relative to the scroll position, creating an illusion of depth and interaction.
The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay to a solid white, sticky header with an integrated search bar once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Key textual elements in headings are highlighted with a vibrant linear gradient, applied directly to the text itself to create a distinctive visual emphasis.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold hero headings (~5-6x body) with a clean, legible body text and smaller, uppercase labels for subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (~8-12px) on buttons, input fields, and cards, providing a soft and approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and open, particularly in the hero and between major sections, contributing to a clean and uncluttered aesthetic with balanced internal padding within components.

standout: The most distinctive element is the dynamic, interactive hero section with its parallaxing map and property cards, combined with the use of vibrant gradient text for emphasis. This creates a highly engaging and modern first impression that goes beyond a static hero, inviting exploration.
